player_prompt.intro:
Sika'y Managpapat {player_id} ed sakey a {num_rounds}-round na palaro na Bato-Papel-Gunting.
Say tuyo mo'y manalo na marakap a bilang na rounds.
Diad kada round, ibaga mo'y sakey ed sarayan: '[rock]', '[paper]', o '[scissors]'.
Saray '[r]', '[p]', o '[s]' et pwede met la'y gamiten a shorthand.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Say move di nakilala. Gawaten ya [rock], [paper], o [scissors].

game_action.selects: Pinili na manlalako {player_id} so move ya {move}.

message.round_win: Resulta na round: Manalo so {winner} ya manlalaban!

outcome.p0_wins: Say Player 0 so analo ed dakel a round!
outcome.p1_wins: Say manalo so Player 1 ed saray marakep a rounds!
